_comment: Windowed renderer corpus (Rust migration Phase 8, ADR-015). Driven by scripts/harness/render_corpus.py. Entries with `demo`/`cmds` capture -renderhash chains and TGA screenshots; entries with `timedemo` measure fps without the fixed timestep. `ssim` thresholds are per platform_key() (mean 8x8-window SSIM, derived from C-vs-C --stability minima minus a margin); `default` applies elsewhere.
